text:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem. We're consistently losing track of postmortem actions after KV write-path incidents. Proposing a tiny 'follow-up playbook' + an IC rotation tweak so remediation ownership actually sticks. Thoughts?
sam: +1. We need named owners (not team names) and a hard due date. Also +1 for auto-reminders.
kevin: From product: agree owner + SLA-style remediation windows (P1=2w, P2=4w). Keeps expectations clear.
anya: Minimal template idea: Owner, Priority, Due, Verification steps, Done criteria, Recurring flag, Postmortem link.
maria: Draft template I sketched:
Owner: <name>
Priority: P1/P2
Due: YYYY-MM-DD
Verification: link to smoke test/checklist
Done criteria: e.g. "no write errors for 72h, tail latency within X%"
Recurring?: yes/no + notes on pattern
Postmortem: <url>
Notes: short RCA + mitigation
jess: Can we add comms cadence fields? Eg who to ping at 24h/72h and reporting cadence (daily while open, then weekly).
sam: Suggest IC-run 15-min sync 48h after incident to confirm owners and timelines so nothing falls through.
incident-bot: Tip: use `/remind` to create channel reminders and link to GH project automation for ownership tracking.
maria: For IC rotation: recommend 2-week rotations and a 'shadow' during big releases to keep continuity.
kevin: :thumbsup: shorter rotations are good. Ops: we need an easy calendar edit flow.
anya: I'll update the rota sheet with a quick handoff row: current incidents, open actions, assigned owners, contact points.
sam: If everyone ok, maria will create GH issue template + tracker and I'll wire Slack reminders + webhook to keep the tracker in sync.
maria: Will post the GH template and initial tracker rows by EOD and assign preliminary owners: kevin (KV mitigation), jess (verification/tests), sam (reminder automation).
jess: Ack, I'll add a CI smoke job for verification and link it in the tracker.
maria: Thanks all — will post links and automation steps later today. :pray:
